summary: Implemented the rich_measure for Tree and rich.align.VerticalCenter feature. Changes: rich/console.py (print passes justify="default" to render options); rich/tree.py (iterative Tree.__rich_measure__ plus Measurement import); rich/align.py (Align width constraint to measured maximum, Align.__repr__, new VerticalCenter class); CHANGELOG.md (9.8.0 marked Unreleased, Added subheading with two entries); tests/test_tree.py (test_measure_tree expecting Measurement(11, 19)); tests/test_align.py (repr, vertical-center render, measure, and tall-content tests). Existing tests were not modified. Tests were NOT run, per instructions, so the changes are verified by reading only. The main risk is that the new Align width constraint could affect existing width-related align tests. Nothing was committed.
